Class Shoot

java.lang.Object
enemy.ability.Shoot
public final class Shoot extends Object
The Shoot ability: while its key is held, a shot charges, and its power grows with the time; letting go fires a Shot from the drop, in the direction aimed at. Held longer than CHARGE_TIME, the charge goes past its maximum and blows the drop up.

The world tells it the key and the aim once a frame with hold(Droplet, boolean, double, double, boolean), then lets the time pass with charge(double). The aim is either given as a direction, by a stick, or turned step by step, by two keys; an arrow shows it while the shot charges.

  • Method Details

    • hold

      public Shot hold(Droplet drop, boolean keyHeld, double directionX, double directionY, boolean allowed)
      Tells the ability whether the shoot key is held and where the player aims, once a frame. Holding the key starts a charge; letting go fires it.
      Parameters:
      drop - the player's drop, which the ball leaves from
      keyHeld - whether the shoot key is held
      directionX - x of the direction aimed at, of any length; 0 with directionY to keep the last one
      directionY - y of the direction aimed at
      allowed - whether the player can shoot; a charge never starts otherwise
      Returns:
      the ball fired when the key has just been let go, or null

    • charge

      public boolean charge(double dt)
      Lets the time pass on the charge.
      Parameters:
      dt - time since the last frame, in s
      Returns:
      true if the charge has gone past its maximum: the drop blows up, and the charge is lost

    • turn

      public void turn(int direction, double dt)
      Turns the aim of the shot being charged, once a frame: one step when a turn key is pressed, then more steps while it stays held. Nothing turns when no shot is charging.
      Parameters:
      direction - -1 to turn left (counter-clockwise on screen), 1 to turn right, 0 when no turn key is held
      dt - time since the last frame, in s
